newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA PRICES IPO AT PLN 55-65.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA PRICES IPO AT PLN 55-65.

text.p: Polish paint maker Polifarb Debica SA has set the issue price of its February initial public offering at between 55 and 65 zlotys, the firm said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.

The firm, which seeks a main market listing, said the final issue price would be set with the help of book building and would be published no later than two days before the offering starts on February 17.

Large investors will subscribe for 350,000 shares on February 17 and 18, while retail investors and current shareholders will subscribe for 150,000 and 200,000 shares respectively from February 17 to February 21.
The firm's 1,335,000 existing shares have also been approved for public trade.
Polifarb Debica's main shareholders are National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 11, which has a 33-percent stake, and the state treasury, with 25 percent.
In the January-September period of 1996 it showed a net profit of 10.2 million zlotys on 111.3-million-zloty-sales.
It expects its net profit to rise to 17 million zlotys in 1997 on sales of 148.1 million zlotys.
